incoming.name: Christmas Island
incoming.excerpt: Ferns, orchids and vines grow on the branches in the humid atmosphere beneath the canopy.

incoming.name: Devonian
incoming.excerpt: By the Late Devonian, forests of small, primitive plants existed: lycophytes, sphenophytes, ferns, and progymnosperms had evolved.

incoming.name: Extinction
incoming.excerpt: For example, a fern that depends on dense shade for protection from direct sunlight can no longer survive without forest to house it.

incoming.name: Geology of the Grand Canyon area
incoming.excerpt: Fossils of winged insects, cone-bearing plants, and ferns are found in this formation as well as tracks of amphibians and reptiles.

incoming.name: Jurassic
incoming.excerpt: Great plant-eating dinosaurs ( sauropods) roamed the land late in the period, feeding on prairies of ferns and palm-like cycads and bennettitales.

incoming.name: Nicaragua
incoming.excerpt: Oaks, pines, moss, ferns and orchids are abundant in the cloud forests of the region.

incoming.name: Oligocene
incoming.excerpt: The legumes of the pea and bean family spread, and sedges, bulrushes and ferns continued their ascent.

incoming.name: Permian
incoming.excerpt: Such dry conditions favored gymnosperms, plants with seeds enclosed in a protective cover, over plants such as ferns that disperse spores.

outgoing.name: Carboniferous
outgoing.excerpt: Ferns first appear in the fossil record in the early-Carboniferous period.

outgoing.name: Coal
outgoing.excerpt: The important fossil fuel coal consists of the remains of primitive plants, including ferns.

outgoing.name: Cretaceous
outgoing.excerpt: The "great fern radiation" occurred in the late-Cretaceous, when many modern families of ferns first appeared.

outgoing.name: Invasive species
outgoing.excerpt: Several ferns are noxious weeds or invasive species, including Japanese climbing fern ( Lygodium japonicum), mosquito fern and sensitive fern (Onoclea sensibilis).

outgoing.name: New Zealand
outgoing.excerpt: Unidentified fern with spores showing in Rotorua, NZ.

outgoing.name: Triassic
outgoing.excerpt: By the Triassic, the first evidence of ferns related to several modern families appeared.
